data_description.containers: Monitors Home Assistant Core, the Supervisor and the add-ons: state, version, CPU and memory. Monitoring only: nothing is restarted.
data_description.database: The recorder's database: its size, its retention, the entities that write the most; purge their history, leave them out, purge and repack. No entities of its own.
data_description.security: Refused logins (kept 7 days, notified from the Internet), accounts and 2FA, long-lived tokens to revoke, exposure, add-ons and credentials written in clear in the YAML files. No entities of its own.
data_description.logs: Home Assistant's log grouped by integration: the errors and warnings, how many times each came, its traceback; reload an integration, ignore a message. No entities of its own.
data_description.watchdog: Reloads the integrations whose entities are all unavailable.
data_description.marketplace: Checks every repository installed from the Marketplace for updates, on the server. The Marketplace itself reads the catalog every 6 hours and only checks custom repositories every 48 hours.
data_description.backups: Follows Home Assistant's backups: the last successful one, the next one, each location and the last 30 days. No entities of its own.
data_description.silent: Follows the devices of ZHA, Zigbee2MQTT, Z-Wave, Matter, ESPHome and deCONZ: the ones not heard from for a while, and the weak signals. No entities of its own.
data_description.batteries: Notifies twice a day the devices whose battery has stayed low.
data_description.git_sync: Home Assistant folder versioned with Git and pushed to a remote (GitHub, Gitea…).
data_description.orphans: Lists the entities that their integration no longer provides, so that you can remove them in bulk.
data_description.automations: Shows the failed automations and the unavailable entities reported by the Automation Monitor integration (installed separately). No entities of its own.

**{title}** ({domain}) is still unavailable after {attempt} reloads by System Hub, which won't reload it again until one of its entities is available.

Check the device or service it connects to, and the logs. This issue goes away once the integration has recovered.

Submit to try again now: System Hub forgets its reloads and reloads the integration.

abort.reload_started: Reloading **{title}**: its reloads were reset and System Hub starts over. This issue goes away as soon as the reload starts; a failure is in the logs.

diverged.title: Versioning cannot push {repo}
diverged.description:
The branch has {ahead} local commits that are not on {upstream}, and {upstream} has {behind} commits that are not here. Versioning does not merge diverged histories by itself, so nothing is pushed.

To resolve it, open a terminal in {repo} and run:

```
git pull --rebase
```

Fix any conflict (edit the files, `git add` them, then `git rebase --continue`), then press **Commit and push** again. This repair goes away with the next successful push.

behind_remote.title: Versioning cannot push {repo}
behind_remote.description: {upstream} has {behind} commits that are not here and **Pull before push** is off in the Versioning options, so nothing is pushed. Turn it on, or run `git pull --rebase` in a terminal in {repo}. This repair goes away with the next successful push.
